title: Placing Various Fractions
objective: Practice placing various fractions on the number line.

problems.text: Locate and label the following fractions on the number line: 0/6, 6/6, 12/6, 3/6, 9/6
Locate and label the following fractions on the number line: 8/4, 6/4, 12/4, 16/4, 4/4
Locate and label the following fractions on the number line: 18/3, 14/3, 9/3, 11/3, 6/3

For a measurement project in math class, students measured the lengths of their pinky fingers. Alex's measured 2 inches long. Jeremiah's pinky finger was 7/4 inches long. Whose finger is longer? Draw a number line to help prove your answer.
